messages.content: You are cross-examining other auditors. For EACH finding listed, decide whether it is a real defect in the code shown. Reply with JSON only: {"votes":[{"ref":"<auditor>:<id>","vote":"AGREE|DISAGREE","reason":"..."}],"missed":[{"severity":"...","file":"...","line":0,"issue":"...","evidence":"...","fix":"..."}]}

AUDIT QUESTION: Batch 68 = the publishing kit and law L-t. Law L-t (orchestrator 2026-11-12): a moments package's ONE title and caption travel in the EDL, sealed and gated, and all audience-facing text is in the integrity class. Measured (2026-11-13 17:12, pin 0c68b589, the first full pass): the kit delivered as Telegram 67848 suggested the title 'bitcoin | Pulse Check' and opened its description with 'bitcoin.'. telegram.publish_kit took edl['headline'] or edl['topic'] ('bitcoin'). The EDL carried title 'No single owner controls the bitcoin network' and the sealed caption, which the kit never read. The videos and their captions were not affected.
The change (pipeline/telegram.py, publish_kit only): title = edl['title'] when present (moments pins). The suggested title is that title + ' | Pulse Check' (the kit's existing format), and the description's lead is the sealed caption. When there is no title (story pins), headline / topic exactly as before. If a title is present and the caption is empty, the lead falls back to '<title>.'.
Tests: test_telegram_delivery.test_a_moments_kit_carries_the_sealed_title_and_caption. It FAILS on the old telegram.py ('SUGGESTED TITLE: bitcoin | Pulse Check') and passes on the fix. test_telegram_delivery + test_review_drop: 41 passed (the story-pin kit test unchanged).
FIND: a moments kit that can still carry a title or caption other than the sealed ones; a change to a story pin's kit; any other audience-facing text in the kit that is not sealed; a test that does not test what it claims. Only state what you can verify from the diff. Reply with the JSON verdict; keep the reasoning short; at most 3 findings.

CODE:

===== DIFF (cat STEP.diff) =====
diff --git a/pipeline/telegram.py b/pipeline/telegram.py
index e34efbba..a1cc9c23 100644
--- a/pipeline/telegram.py
+++ b/pipeline/telegram.py
@@ -325,9 +325,11 @@ def publish_kit(run_dir, snap=None):
             vids.setdefault(seg["channel"], [])
             if seg["video_id"] not in vids[seg["channel"]]:
                 vids[seg["channel"]].append(seg["video_id"])
-    headline = (edl.get("headline") or edl.get("topic") or "").strip().rstrip(".")
+    title = (edl.get("title") or "").strip()        # law L-t: a moments pin's ONE sealed title and caption (17:12: the
+    headline = title or (edl.get("headline") or edl.get("topic") or "").strip().rstrip(".")   # kit said 'bitcoin')
+    lead = ((edl.get("caption") or "").strip() if title else "") or f"{headline}."
     lines = [f"SUGGESTED TITLE: {headline} | Pulse Check", "", "DESCRIPTION:",
-             f"{headline}. Every clip in this Pulse Check is a creator's own words; go follow them:"]
+             f"{lead} Every clip in this Pulse Check is a creator's own words; go follow them:"]
     missing = [ch for ch in credited if not (reg.get(ch, {}).get("yt_handle") and reg.get(ch, {}).get("url")
                                              and vids.get(ch))]
     if not credited or missing:                      # Claude-gates X4: never a bare name or an empty link

+    def test_a_moments_kit_carries_the_sealed_title_and_caption(self):
+        # 17:12 (pin 0c68b589, Telegram 67848): the kit suggested 'bitcoin | Pulse Check' from the EDL's topic, not
+        # the ONE sealed title and caption the moments EDL carries (law L-t)
+        edl = json.load(open(os.path.join(make_run(self.tmp, attest=False), "edl.json")))
+        edl.update(topic="bitcoin", headline=None, title="No single owner controls the bitcoin network",
+                   caption="bitcoin is not a partisan issue. no ceo or committee keeps its rules.")
+        _, sent = self.deliver(make_run(self.tmp, edl=edl))
+        kit = sent[-1][2]["text"]
+        self.assertIn("SUGGESTED TITLE: No single owner controls the bitcoin network | Pulse Check", kit)
+        self.assertIn("DESCRIPTION:\nbitcoin is not a partisan issue. no ceo or committee keeps its rules. Every clip",
+                      kit)
+        self.assertNotIn("SUGGESTED TITLE: bitcoin", kit)
+
+
